items.description: Use a Specle-owned custom URI base for packaged JSON Schema identifiers.
items.analysis: The former GitHub-shaped base identified packaged schemas but misleadingly resembled a downloadable repository URL. `specle://schemas/` is a stable logical identifier resolved only by Specle's registry.
items.recommendation: Change every packaged schema `$id`, registry identifier, and generated registry entry to the `specle://schemas/<name>/1.0` scheme, without introducing network resolution.

items.description: Remove or justify the unused common schema record shape, including its path field.
items.evidence: src/specle/schemas/common/1.0.json:5-18; no `$ref` or runtime consumer outside schema registration.
items.analysis: The `record` definition requires `name`, `path`, and `status`, but no packaged schema references it and no runtime code consumes it. Its `path` property has no current purpose.
items.recommendation: Remove `common/1.0` from the packaged registry and distribution unless a concrete shared contract needs it; do not retain an unused generic path field.
